title: Baghdad
sideASummary: Infection deck back. Red biohazard on a dark field. No printed text.
sideBSummary: BAGHDAD printed vertically, code P2-06b. Map fragment, green ring, and a dashed white panel. No coordinates and no rules text.

rules: The dashed white panel is the infection-card upgrade slot. The green ring is the standard infection mark.
notes: This copy prints P2-06b, the same code as the other Baghdad Infection card (index 6). No P2-05b is printed on the face.
The recon report puts both Baghdad Infection cards in the Game End area.
